item: Settings repair keeps a paused Wikipedia lane paused and says why it pauses a running one
summary: Replacing damaged scheduler settings wrote wiki_lane_state halted every time, silently (the likely cause of OOS-3's multi-day pause). The repair now keeps a recorded halted or stopped state with its record, and pauses a lane last known running on purpose, recording the pause as by settings-replacement: the replacement resets editions (all twelve) and the storage budget (150 GB) to defaults, and running on them would widen what the operator chose; running is never taken from a record, which can be stale after a backup restore. One WARNING names every switch written OFF and why the lane paused; the config route answers written_off beside reset, and the lane state is no longer listed as reset. Checked: only the scheduler replacement writes non-default values (six network switches OFF, deliberate); app and custody replacements reset to defaults. No UI reads reset or written_off yet (follow-up, needs x12 strings).
